newsitem.title: LATVIA: C.BANK ASSETS DIP IN FEB TO 542.5 MLN LATS.
newsitem.headline: C.BANK ASSETS DIP IN FEB TO 542.5 MLN LATS.

text.p: Latvia's central bank assets dipped in February to 542.5 million lats from 556.2 million lats the previous month, the bank said on Friday.
The central bank said its foreign convertible assets fell by 10.5 million lats to 504.4 million -- or 2.1 percent.
The fall was due to the repeated utilisation of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) loan by the government, which has been repaid and included in the bank's assets, the bank said in a statement.
Notes and coins in circulation rose by three percent to 282.9 from 274.8 million lats.

The rise was due to various factors which included the fall in local central bank credits as there was little demand for repo and lombard credits among commercial banks, and the growth of lat deposits in the central bank of the commercial banks.
The bank's capital and reserves fell slightly to 22.7 million lats from 24.7 million, it added.
